title: Chicken Bake (Cheddar Bay Biscuit Topping)
creator: Mamas Down South Kitchen
cookTime: Bake 30-35 minutes at 350 degrees F, then rest 15 minutes
ingredients: Filling: 2 pounds cooked and shredded chicken
Filling: 1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of chicken soup
Filling: 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and all-purpose seasoning of choice
Topping: 1 box Red Lobster Cheddar Bay Biscuit Mix
Butter to top: 1/2 stick (4 tablespoons) butter
Butter to top: the seasoning packet that comes with the biscuit mix
Nonstick spray for the baking dish
instructions: Step 1: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F.
Step 2: In a large mixing bowl, combine everything for the filling until well combined.
Step 3: Spray a 9x13 baking dish with nonstick spray and add the chicken filling.
Step 4: In a separate bowl, mix the biscuit mix, milk, and cheese for the topping. Spread it evenly over the chicken mixture.
Step 5: Bake at 350 degrees F for 30-35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Step 6: Let the chicken bake sit for 15 minutes.
Step 7: Melt the butter and stir in the seasoning packet from the biscuit mix. Brush evenly over the chicken bake.
notes: From a Mamas Down South Kitchen Facebook reel; the creator titled it simply 'Chicken Bake'. Recipe from the creator's reply under the pinned 'Author' comment. The creator also linked a Walmart grocery list (https://walmrt.us/4keYgCI) and a cookbook preorder. Judy Beth Hegwer adds a veggie (broccoli, corn, peas and carrots, onions); Lindsey Harris Jackson also uses Cheddar Bay biscuit mix in sausage balls and on chicken pot pie. Not stated: servings and prep time.
